name: Network Post Duplicator
author: jvelgar

sections.description:
Network Post Duplicator PRO introduces a full parent/child sync model, advanced synchronization controls, and a modern admin UX for high-volume multisite publishing.

Main PRO capabilities:

  1. Parent-child relationship model with sync status map (npd_children_map)
  2. Selective Sync policy (global + per post override)
  3. Post meta duplication and synchronization with blacklist + replace/merge mode
  4. SEO meta presets (Yoast, RankMath, AIOSEO)
  5. ACF support with special field handling (image, gallery, file, relationship, post_object)
  6. Advanced media sync:
    • Featured image mapping
    • Embedded uploads URL detection and rewrite
    • Gutenberg/gallery ID remap support
  7. Bulk duplication action from list tables
  8. Batch processing for bulk operations
  9. Child post parent-linking metadata and quick access to the parent edit screen
  10. Dedicated top-level admin menu (outside default Settings area)
  11. Modernized settings UI with card-based layout
  12. Contextual help tips (i) and built-in Instructions modal
  13. Capability hardening (npd_manage_duplication) and multisite-safe blog switching with guaranteed restore flow

This release is focused on making the plugin commercially viable for premium multisite workflows.
sections.installation:
1. Activate the plugin in a WordPress Multisite installation.
  2. Go to Network Post Duplicator in the left admin menu.
  3. Configure:
    • Enabled post types
    • Global selective sync policy
    • Meta/ACF strategy
    • Media strategy
    • Bulk target sites
  4. Edit any enabled post type and use the Network Post Duplicator PRO metabox:
    • Choose target sites
    • Keep global policy or set post-specific policy
    • Save to create/update child posts according to your sync settings
    • If the post is a child, use Open parent post for quick navigation

2.0.0

  • Added parent-child sync contract (npd_children_map)
  • Added selective sync policy (global + per post)
  • Added post meta sync with blacklist and replace/merge mode
  • Added SEO presets for Yoast, RankMath and AIOSEO
  • Added ACF support for special field types and relationship strategy
  • Added advanced media sync and embedded media URL rewrite
  • Added bulk duplication action and batch processing
  • Added child-to-parent reference and quick parent link in the metabox
  • Moved plugin page to its own top-level admin menu
  • Added modern card-based admin UI, contextual help tips, and instructions modal
  • Removed obsolete “Sync now” UI action from settings/metabox flow
  • Added custom capability (npd_manage_duplication) and nonce hardening
  • Added multisite-safe switching patterns and sync status logging

1.4.3

  • Security hardening and settings sanitization
  • Tested WordPress 6.9
